note: Actual shipments verified: 3 export consignments of synthetic iron oxide pigment red (HS 28211010) from Raxaul, India to Birgunj, Nepal, dated 2024-04-09, 2024-11-30 and 2025-09-02, with B/L numbers 8999598, 6052304 and 3503496. All three go to the same Nepal buyer group (A S T Pvt Ltd / A.S.T Pvt Ltd / A.S.T.Pvt.Ltd, Adarsh Nagar-13, Birgunj) — a single cross-border land route, so the export footprint is real but narrow and concentrated on one counterparty. Declared HS set was 260111;262021;282110: the 282110 (iron oxides) line is confirmed by customs records; the 260111 (iron ore fines) and 262021 (slag/ash) lines have no shipment record in the visible data and are not confirmed — per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground, the working HS should be treated as 28211010. Registered address shown in the customs header: 'SECTOR B PLOT NO-16 & 17, SIRGITTI INDUSTRIAL AREA' (Nagpur, Maharashtra) — this is an address string from the trade record, not a verified registry extract. Domestic supply side is genuinely unknown, not negative: no evidence found either way, so it is recorded as unknown rather than none_found.
